headline: Iran Raises Terms While Tanker Claim Remains Unverified
deck: Tehran restated its conditions for talks; maritime monitors have not confirmed the reported mine strikes.
body: Iran said Tuesday that it would not hold talks with the United States to end the conflict unless its conditions were met. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, speaking as head of the Iranian delegation in the Islamabad talks, said there would be no further negotiations or action before Washington moved. [E2][E4]

Tasnim reported that the IRGC Navy claimed three commercial tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. ÆGIR said the claim concerned vessels in unauthorized corridors and remained an assertion that UKMTO and the Joint Maritime Information Centre had not confirmed. [E1][E5]

The Joint Maritime Information Centre said in a report covering 19 to 21 November that it recorded 114 passages through the strait with U.S. assistance, and that claims of tankers hitting naval mines were unconfirmed; ÆGIR likewise said neither it nor UKMTO had confirmed mine detonations or hull breaches. Since this paper’s 24 November coverage, Iran’s terms for talks have been stated again, but the reported strikes’ confirmed status has not changed. [E3][E6]
